name: Weaver Isobel

intro.text: I work at a mill that makes tweed. The cloth came from a clerk's spelling mistake, which is more than I can say for my mother-in-law's knitwear.

win: That was a very smooth weave. I'll mark it down in the pattern book.
after: Tweed's the only cloth that actually gets better in the rain. It's the one thing I have in common with it.
